query:
SELECT 
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_address = '0x053c91253bc9682c04929ca02ed00b3e423f6710d2ee7e0d5ebb06f3ecf368a8' THEN total_amount END), 0) as total_usdc_pooled,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_address = '0x068f5c6a61780768455de69077e07e89787839bf8166decfbf92b645209c0fb8' THEN total_amount END), 0) as total_usdt_pooled,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_address = '0x049d36570d4e46f48e99674bd3fcc84644ddd6b96f7c741b1562b82f9e004dc7' THEN total_amount END), 0) as total_eth_pooled,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_address = '0x04718f5a0fc34cc1af16a1cdee98ffb20c31f5cd61d6ab07201858f4287c938d' THEN total_amount END), 0) as total_strk_pooled,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN token_address = '0x03fe2b97c1fd336e750087d68b9b867997fd64a2661ff3ca5a7c771641e8e7ac' THEN total_amount END), 0) as total_wbtc_pooled
        FROM crowd_funding_token_balances
